vehicle_documents_expiry_idx.name: vehicle_documents_expiry_idx
vehicle_documents_expiry_idx.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND expires_at IS NOT NULL

vehicle_inspections_result_chk.name: vehicle_inspections_result_chk
vehicle_inspections_result_chk.value: overall_result IS NULL OR overall_result IN ('pass', 'pass_with_notes', 'fail')

vehicles_active_vin_uq.name: vehicles_active_vin_uq
vehicles_active_vin_uq.where: vin IS NOT NULL AND status NOT IN ('delivered', 'removed')

vehicles_prices_chk.name: vehicles_prices_chk
vehicles_prices_chk.value: (asking_price IS NULL OR asking_price >= 0) AND (min_price IS NULL OR min_price >= 0)

vehicle_costs_source_uq.name: vehicle_costs_source_uq
vehicle_costs_source_uq.where: source_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'rejected'
